summary: New Phase-0/1 spike for a standalone token-consumption-tracker plugin: stream-parses the current session's transcript JSONL (assistant records' message.usage) to sum real token counts, with a turn-level (not call-level) coldstart-attribution pass keyed on tool names starting with mcp__coldstart__. Derives its own transcript path deterministically — cwd-encoded (each "/" and "." replaced with "-", confirmed against a real ~/.claude/projects dir name) plus an exact session id passed in by the caller, never a "most recently modified file" guess. Validated this session: output matched a manual jq sum over this session's own live transcript exactly.
